method: Doc source that tai dung file:line cua tung finding, doc them cac ham goi khi sink nam trong ham private.
Nhan dat theo DUONG DI DU LIEU, khong theo ten lesson, ten file hay ten rule.
true_positive doi hoi thay ro du lieu tu request chay toi sink.
false_positive danh cho sink chi nhan chuoi hang, ke ca khi file mang ten SqlInjection.
needs_review danh cho truong hop du lieu co nguon nguoi dung nhung con mot mat xich chua chung minh duoc tu bang chung da doc (vd. co sanitization mot phan, hoac entry point nam ngoai file).

cases.label: true_positive
cases.dataflow: POST /InsecureDeserialization/task -> @RequestParam token -> base64 -> ObjectInputStream.readObject() -> VulnerableTaskHolder.readObject() gan taskAction -> exec(taskAction)
cases.reason: taskAction den tu luong serialized do nguoi dung nop, khong phai hang. Sink thuc thi lenh he dieu hanh.
cases.caveat: Co chan startsWith('sleep'|'ping') va length<22, va Runtime.exec(String) khong goi shell nen khong noi lenh bang ';'. Tac dong bi gioi han nhung sink van nhan du lieu do nguoi dung anh huong.

cases.label: needs_review
cases.dataflow: SecurityContext principal -> WebGoatUser.getUsername() -> noi chuoi vao lenh SET SCHEMA
cases.reason: Username la du lieu nguoi dung tu dat luc dang ky, nen KHONG phai hang. Nhung file nay khong cho thay username duoc kiem tra the nao luc dang ky, nen kha nang khai thac chua chung minh duoc tu bang chung da doc.
cases.must_not_claim: Khong duoc goi la confirmed SQL Injection chi vi co noi chuoi.

cases.label: needs_review
cases.dataflow: addUser(username, ...) -> WebGoatUser -> createLessonsForUser -> noi chuoi vao lenh DDL CREATE SCHEMA
cases.reason: Cung dang voi opengrep-002, va o day la DDL chay voi quyen dba. Van thieu bang chung ve rang buoc dinh dang username.
cases.caveat: Neu doc them tang dang ky ma thay username khong duoc rang buoc thi nhan nay len true_positive.

cases.label: true_positive
cases.dataflow: POST /InsecureDeserialization/task -> @RequestParam String token -> Base64.decode -> ObjectInputStream.readObject()
cases.reason: Chuoi do nguoi dung nop duoc giai tuan tu truc tiep, khong co allowlist lop. Entry point nam ngay trong file.

cases.label: needs_review
cases.dataflow: fromString(String s) -> Base64.decode -> readObject(). Nguon cua s khong xuat hien trong file.
cases.reason: Ham tien ich khong co entry point. Khong doc duoc caller thi khong chung minh duoc du lieu tu request chay toi day.
cases.must_not_claim: Khong duoc suy ra attacker control chi vi ten package la 'deserialization'.

cases.label: true_positive
cases.sink: executeQuery("SELECT key FROM jwt_keys WHERE id = '" + kid + "'")
cases.dataflow: POST kid/delete -> @RequestParam token -> JWS header 'kid' -> noi thang vao chuoi SQL
cases.reason: Header cua JWT do nguoi gui token dat toan quyen, va no duoc noi vao truy van truoc khi chu ky duoc xac minh.

cases.label: true_positive
cases.dataflow: PUT /SqlInjectionAdvanced/register -> @RequestParam username_reg -> "... userid = '" + username + "'" -> executeQuery
cases.reason: Tham so request duoc noi truc tiep vao menh de WHERE.

cases.label: true_positive
cases.dataflow: accountName tu request -> query = "... last_name = '" + accountName + "'" -> executeSqlInjection -> executeQuery
cases.reason: Chuoi truy van duoc dung tu tham so request roi truyen qua mot ham trung gian toi sink.
cases.caveat: unionQueryChecker chi PHAN LOAI co dung UNION hay khong; no khong chan gi ca.

cases.label: false_positive
cases.dataflow: query = "SELECT password FROM user_system_data WHERE user_name = 'dave'" — chuoi hang, khong co bien nao noi vao.
cases.reason: Truy van la hang tuyet doi. Rule chi bat viec dung Statement thay vi PreparedStatement.
cases.must_not_claim: Khong duoc trinh bay la SQL Injection muc high.

cases.label: true_positive
cases.dataflow: POST /SqlInjection/attack10 -> @RequestParam action_string -> "... action LIKE '%" + action + "%'" -> executeQuery
cases.reason: Tham so request noi thang vao menh de LIKE.

cases.label: false_positive
cases.dataflow: Chuoi hang viet thang trong loi goi, khong co bien nao.
cases.reason: tableExists() chi kiem tra bang co ton tai khong. Khong co dau vao nao.
cases.must_not_claim: Khong duoc trinh bay la SQL Injection muc high.

cases.label: true_positive
cases.dataflow: POST /SqlInjection/attack2 -> @RequestParam String query -> executeQuery(query)
cases.reason: Toan bo cau truy van CHINH LA tham so request. Day la muc kiem soat cao nhat co the.

cases.label: true_positive
cases.dataflow: POST /SqlInjection/attack3 -> @RequestParam String query -> executeUpdate(query)
cases.reason: Cau lenh ghi du lieu lay nguyen tham so request.

cases.label: false_positive
cases.dataflow: Chuoi hang. Cung ham voi opengrep-013 nhung khac dong va khac bien.
cases.reason: Day la truy van kiem tra ket qua bai hoc, khong nhan dau vao nao.
cases.must_not_claim: Khong duoc gop chung ket luan voi opengrep-013 chi vi cung file va cung ham.

cases.label: true_positive
cases.dataflow: POST /SqlInjection/attack4 -> @RequestParam String query -> executeUpdate(query)
cases.reason: Giong opengrep-013: tham so request la toan bo cau lenh.

cases.label: false_positive
cases.dataflow: Chuoi hang.
cases.reason: Truy van kiem tra cot phone co ton tai khong.
cases.must_not_claim: Khong duoc gop chung ket luan voi opengrep-015.

cases.label: true_positive
cases.dataflow: POST /SqlInjection/attack5 -> tham so 'query' (Spring bind theo ten, khong can @RequestParam) -> executeQuery(query)
cases.reason: Thieu annotation khong lam tham so het la du lieu tu request; Spring van bind theo ten.

cases.label: true_positive
cases.dataflow: POST /SqlInjection/assignment5a -> account + operator + injection (ca ba deu la @RequestParam) -> noi vao WHERE -> executeQuery
cases.reason: Ba tham so request duoc ghep lai roi noi vao truy van.

cases.label: true_positive
cases.dataflow: POST /SqlInjection/attack8 -> @RequestParam name, auth_tan -> noi ca hai vao WHERE -> executeQuery
cases.reason: Hai tham so request noi thang vao truy van.

cases.label: needs_review
cases.dataflow: log(connection, query) duoc goi voi chinh cau truy van cua nguoi dung -> action.replace('\'', '"') -> noi vao INSERT INTO access_log
cases.reason: Du lieu VAN do nguoi dung kiem soat, nhung dau nhay don bi thay bang nhay kep truoc khi noi. Day la injection bac hai voi sanitization mot phan: kha nang thoat chuoi chua chung minh duoc tu bang chung da doc.
cases.must_not_claim: Khong duoc goi la false_positive: du lieu that su do nguoi dung kiem soat.

cases.label: true_positive
cases.dataflow: POST /SqlInjection/attack9 -> @RequestParam name, auth_tan -> noi vao WHERE -> execute
cases.reason: Hai tham so request noi thang vao truy van roi thuc thi.

cases.label: false_positive
cases.dataflow: getSqlInt la ham private. Ca ba noi goi trong file (getMaxSalary, getSumSalariesOfOtherEmployees, getJohnSalary) deu truyen chuoi hang.
cases.reason: Sink nhan tham so, nhung phai doc caller moi ket luan duoc. Doc het ba caller thi khong caller nao dua du lieu nguoi dung vao.
cases.must_not_claim: Khong duoc danh true_positive chi vi sink nhan mot bien.

cases.label: false_positive
cases.dataflow: query = "SELECT * FROM employees ORDER BY salary DESC" — hang, gan ngay dong tren.
cases.reason: Truy van hang dung de dung bang hien thi ket qua bai hoc.
cases.must_not_claim: Khong duoc trinh bay la SQL Injection muc high.
